generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

itemList.description: Providing, supplying, fabricating, transporting, and installing structural steel members of required size for gantry structures as per approved drawings. The work includes cutting, welding, drilling, and assembling of steel sections, providing base plates and necessary fittings, applying primer and paint, transporting materials to site, and erecting the structure with proper alignment. All labour, materials, Crane charge, tools, equipment, and safety measures required to complete the work shall be included, as per the directions of the Engineer-in-Charge. (Refer Annexure 1 for detailed specifications.)
